name: Example Payable Agent
description: Neutral demo agent card for the capability-descriptors demo. Advertises payment tooling as its worked example capability: a caller that has discovered this agent via ANS follows the endpoint's metaDataUrl to this descriptor and learns how to transact. Fixture only - nothing at agent.example.com serves it.

skills.name: get_payment_requirements
skills.description: Quote the payment requirements for calling this agent's paid skills. Returns an x402 accepts block (scheme, network, payTo, asset, amount) the caller needs to construct a payment. Quoting only - this skill never moves money.

skills.name: echo
skills.description: Return the message sent, unchanged. Placeholder skill so the card shows a capability beside the payment tooling.
